name: fieldrobin
description: Manage customers, jobs, schedules, and invoices in your FieldRobin workspace.

interface.longDescription: Connect your FieldRobin workspace to find customers and leads, review jobs and schedules, check quotes and invoices, and read business reports. Create customers or jobs only when you ask and grant the matching write permission. FieldRobin accesses records available to the workspace you connect.
capabilities: Create customers and jobs with permission
defaultPrompt: Find unpaid invoices in my workspace.

positive.prompt: Give me a high-level summary of my FieldRobin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the summary and aggregate counts from the connected workspace. Do not invent values that the tool does not return.

positive.prompt: What jobs are scheduled for today?
positive.expected_behavior: List jobs returned for today in the connected workspace and preserve the schedule details returned by FieldRobin.

positive.prompt: Find customers named Avery in my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching customers visible to the connected account. Say when no matches are returned.

positive.prompt: Which invoices in my workspace are still unpaid?
positive.expected_behavior: Report payment status returned by FieldRobin. Do not infer payment or overdue status when the tool does not provide it.

positive.description: Create a customer after an explicit request
positive.prompt: In this test workspace, create a customer named OpenAI Review Fixture.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly one requested customer only after the connected account grants customer-write permission, then report the verified result.

negative.prompt: Show me customers from a FieldRobin workspace I cannot access.
Delete all customers in my FieldRobin workspace.

negative.description: Do not create records without write permission
negative.prompt: Create a customer while this FieldRobin connection has read-only access.

review.commerce_description: FieldRobin reads invoice and payment status. The plugin does not process payments or initiate purchases.

publication.release_notes: Initial portable plugin package with FieldRobin workspace guidance and OAuth MCP connection.
